Bug_Explanation: Connections, streams, files, and other classes that implement the Closeable interface or its super-interface, AutoCloseable, needs to be closed after use. Further, that close call must be made in a finally block otherwise an exception could keep the call from being made. If class implements AutoCloseable, resource should be created using 'try-with-resources' pattern and will be closed automatically.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by not properly closing the Resources in the'showBug' method. The exception is expected because the resources are not properly closed. The test case fails as expected because of this exception.
